jewelry.title: Bracelet made of two parallel strings of cylindrical coconut beads which are connected by carved letters strung between them. The letters spell the personal name "LUCIANA".

Bracelet consisting of two parallel strings of cylindrical coconut beads interspersed with rectangular white beads spanning the two strings (possibly armadillo shell). The bracelet is secured by tying the string.
